roadmap.title: Nero/Dante foundations on Human and Devil Hunter
roadmap.description: Clear Human and Devil Hunter with Nero/Dante, buy core abilities, build the shared upgrade pool, complete every Secret Mission through Mission Select, and learn the Red Orb routes needed for later ranks.

roadmap.title: Difficulty ladder and mission S ranks
roadmap.description: Clear and S-rank Human, Devil Hunter, Son of Sparda, and Dante Must Die with normal Nero/Dante costumes, then use the unlocked Super costumes for boss cleanup.

roadmap.title: Remaining modes and character campaign clears
roadmap.description: Clear and S-rank Legendary Dark Knight with Vergil, assign Heaven or Hell and Hell and Hell to the remaining character sets, and finish all seven distinct game modes.

roadmap.title: Five Bloody Palace clears
roadmap.description: Clear all 101 stages separately with Nero, Dante, Vergil, Lady, and Trish; combine a Super-character run with Turbo, the sub-two-hour target, and Dante's no-damage fight, then earn the overall S rank with a normal-costume run.

roadmap.title: Cumulative kill cleanup
roadmap.description: Use the campaign and Bloody Palace totals first, then finish the 10,000-enemy counter at Mission 10's infinitely respawning Heaven or Hell Scarecrow if necessary.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Human Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions on @mechanic{Human} with any character set.

guide.context: Difficulty clears do not stack, but every mission remains available through Mission Select for cleanup.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Human}, choose any character set, and finish Missions 1–20 on that mode.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Devil Hunter Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions on @mechanic{Devil Hunter} with any character set.

guide.context: Completing Devil Hunter unlocks Son of Sparda for Nero/Dante, Vergil, and Lady/Trish.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Devil Hunter}, choose any character set, and finish Missions 1–20 on that mode.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Son of Sparda Mode.
achievements.summary: Unlock @mechanic{Son of Sparda} through Devil Hunter, then clear all 20 missions on Son of Sparda.

guide.context: The mode unlock is shared across character sets; finishing Son of Sparda also opens Dante Must Die and Heaven or Hell.

steps.text: Finish all 20 missions on @mechanic{Devil Hunter} with any character set to unlock Son of Sparda.
Select @mechanic{Son of Sparda} and complete Missions 1–20 with any character set.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Dante Must Die Mode.
achievements.summary: Unlock @mechanic{Dante Must Die} through Son of Sparda, then clear all 20 Dante Must Die missions.

guide.context: Enemies can enter Devil Trigger if left alive, gaining roughly double health and resisting knockback. A Nero/Dante clear awards their Super costumes, while a Vergil clear awards Super Vergil.

steps.text: Finish all 20 missions on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} to unlock Dante Must Die.
Select @mechanic{Dante Must Die} and complete Missions 1–20 with any character set, using Devil Trigger and items when survival requires them.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Heaven or Hell Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}, where every combatant dies in one hit.

guide.context: Son of Sparda unlocks this mode for every character set, making it the fastest route for a required Vergil or Lady/Trish campaign clear.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Son of Sparda} with any character set to unlock Heaven or Hell.
Select @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}, use ranged attacks to kill enemies before they act, and finish Missions 1–20.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Hell and Hell Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions on @mechanic{Hell and Hell}, where the player dies from one hit.

guide.context: Enemies retain Son of Sparda durability, but each mission supplies three free Gold Orbs before a Continue. Super costumes are eligible because this mode has no separate S-rank achievement.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Dante Must Die} with any character set to unlock Hell and Hell.
Select @mechanic{Hell and Hell}, use a Super character if available, skip encounters that do not seal the room, and finish Missions 1–20.

achievements.description: Clear all game modes.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 missions on each of the seven modes: Human, Devil Hunter, Son of Sparda, Dante Must Die, Heaven or Hell, Hell and Hell, and Legendary Dark Knight.

guide.context: The seven mode clears do not stack, but any character set may supply each one; assigning Vergil and Lady/Trish to two remaining modes also covers their character-clear achievements.

steps.text: Complete Missions 1–20 separately on @mechanic{Human}, @mechanic{Devil Hunter}, @mechanic{Son of Sparda}, and @mechanic{Dante Must Die}.
Complete Missions 1–20 separately on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}, @mechanic{Hell and Hell}, and @mechanic{Legendary Dark Knight}.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Human Mode with an S ranking.
achievements.summary: Record an overall S rank on Missions 1–20 on @mechanic{Human}.

guide.context: Human enemies die quickly, so Red Orb and clear-time multipliers are more dependable than farming Style. More than 95% of available Red Orbs earns the S Orb multiplier.

steps.text: Use a normal costume, avoid items and deaths, and keep Super costumes disabled because their 0.2 score multiplier makes an overall S impractical.
Replay every @mechanic{Human} mission through Mission Select until Missions 1–20 each show an overall S rank, breaking the stage objects and hidden Red Orb caches before finishing.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Devil Hunter Mode with an S ranking.
achievements.summary: Record an overall S rank on Missions 1–20 on @mechanic{Devil Hunter}.

guide.context: Mission score combines Base and Style points with time, Red Orb, and penalty multipliers; a no-item clear adds 1.2, while Continues, Gold Orbs, and Super costumes reduce the result.

steps.text: Use a normal costume, avoid items and deaths, and learn each mission's breakable-object and hidden Red Orb route.
Replay every @mechanic{Devil Hunter} mission until Missions 1–20 each display an overall S rank, varying attacks for Style while collecting more than 95% of available Red Orbs.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Son of Sparda Mode with an S ranking.
achievements.summary: Record an overall S rank on Missions 1–20 on @mechanic{Son of Sparda}.

guide.context: Son of Sparda's larger health pools permit longer Style strings, but optional rooms add their breakables to the available Red Orb total once entered.

steps.text: Use a normal costume, avoid items and deaths, and stay out of optional rooms unless you intend to clear their Red Orbs.
Replay every @mechanic{Son of Sparda} mission until Missions 1–20 each display an overall S rank, combining varied attacks with fast clears and more than 95% Red Orb collection.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Dante Must Die Mode with an S ranking.
achievements.summary: Record an overall S rank on Missions 1–20 on @mechanic{Dante Must Die}.

guide.context: Dante Must Die enemies can enter Devil Trigger, but their extra durability also creates more Style opportunities. Keeping dangerous enemies off camera delays many attacks.

steps.text: Use a normal costume, avoid items, Gold Orbs, Continues, and deaths, and collect more than 95% of each mission's available Red Orbs.
Replay every @mechanic{Dante Must Die} mission until Missions 1–20 each display an overall S rank, using cancellable attacks and crowd control to preserve Style without taking damage.

achievements.description: Clear all secret missions.
achievements.summary: Find and complete all 12 @mechanic{Secret Missions} across Missions 2–17.

guide.context: Each cleared seal turns gray and awards one Blue Orb Fragment. Mission Select allows cleanup, and several trials are designed around abilities bought later in the campaign.

collectibles.name: Annihilation
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 2 — Terrace/Business District}, after the first Grim Grip
collectibles.method: Activate the red seal and kill all eight Scarecrows within one minute, using Snatch to pull the next target close and Buster-heavy combos to finish each enemy.

collectibles.name: Alley-Oop
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4 — corridor to the Dining Room}, behind the launcher broken by a Gyro Blade
collectibles.method: Activate the seal, then chain jump, Snatch, and Buster until Nero performs five mid-air Busters without touching the floor.

collectibles.name: Nonviolent Resistance
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 5 — Soldier's Graveyard}, beneath the exit stairs
collectibles.method: Buy Nero's Hold, activate the seal, carry a Scarecrow as a shield against the Frost attacks, and taunt until the Style meter reaches C without Nero attacking.

collectibles.name: Tracking Treasure Down
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 6 — Angel Creation}, behind a green pod left of the entrance
collectibles.method: Follow Nero's glowing Devil Bringer signal, stand where the glow is strongest until each cache appears, and collect all 99 hidden Red Orbs before time expires.

collectibles.name: Sky Scraper
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7 — Lapis River}, behind the tree left of the stone bridge
collectibles.method: Chain jumps and Hell Bound through each Grim Grip, land on all five rising platforms, break or pass the fenced platform, and reach the goal at the top.

collectibles.name: Vermifuge
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 10 — Security Corridor}, immediately right after the moving lasers
collectibles.method: Use Nero's Hold to carry the Scarecrow up the stairs to the fountain, leave it there, then guard the approach and Buster every Chimera before any Chimera possesses the Scarecrow.

collectibles.name: Free Running
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 12}, immediately right after leaving the Ascension Chamber
collectibles.method: Fill Pandora's Disaster Gauge, activate the seal, select Gunslinger, and use Pandora's Argument to fly from the starting platform to the goal without falling through the vanishing floor.

collectibles.name: Royal Blocker
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 14 — Forest Entrance}, pavilion beside the hollow trunk
collectibles.method: Activate the seal, select Royalguard, face the Mephisto, and time five Royal Blocks exactly as its attacks connect.

collectibles.name: Unbreakable
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 15 — Library}, bottom of the spiral staircase
collectibles.method: Activate the seal and kill every enemy without taking damage or allowing a Fault to capture Dante.

collectibles.name: Puppet Master
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 5 — Master's Chamber}, behind the mirror above the fireplace
collectibles.method: Activate and strike the Gyro Blade, then drive the spinning blade through all five black-and-blue towers without leaving through a door.

collectibles.name: Point of Impact
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — Fortuna Castle Gate}, high ledge marked by three small Red Orbs on the broken snowy stairs
collectibles.method: Enter with Dante, aim horizontally at each of the two distant statues, and fire Pandora's uncharged PF398: Revenge at both statues before time expires.

collectibles.name: Steeplechase
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 17 — Opera House Plaza entrance}, behind the trash can on Dante's right
collectibles.method: Enter with a full Disaster Gauge, activate Devil Trigger, Air Hike and use two Sky Stars, switch to Gunslinger while airborne, then fly to the goal with Pandora's Argument without touching a laser.

achievements.description: Acquire all of Nero's skills.
achievements.summary: Spend 290,450 shared Proud Souls to buy every skill in @npc{Nero's} skill list.

guide.context: Proud Souls come from enemies, mission clears, and Bloody Palace, are shared by all characters, and can be refunded without loss.

steps.text: Accumulate at least 290,450 @item{Proud Souls} through campaign and Bloody Palace play, or refund another character's purchases.
Open Customize, select @npc{Nero}, and purchase every skill shown in Nero's skill list until no unowned entry remains.

achievements.description: Acquire all of Dante's skills.
achievements.summary: Use the shared Proud Soul pool to buy every skill in @npc{Dante's} skill list.

guide.context: Every character draws from the same Proud Soul total, so Nero's purchases can be refunded and immediately reassigned to Dante.

steps.text: Accumulate enough @item{Proud Souls} through campaign and Bloody Palace play, or refund purchased skills from another character.
Open Customize, select @npc{Dante}, and purchase every skill shown in Dante's skill list until no unowned entry remains.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace Mode stages with an S ranking.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 in one run and receive an overall S rank.

guide.context: Super costumes impose a 0.2 score multiplier and make an overall S impractical; Lady and Trish lack Super costumes, so either normal-costume character clear can supply this rank naturally.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Bloody Palace} with a normal-costume character who has every skill and health upgrade, then clear stages 1–101 without items or a death.
Finish the stage-101 Dante fight and confirm the Bloody Palace results screen awards an overall S rank.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 enemies.
achievements.summary: Defeat 100 enemies across campaign missions or @loc{Bloody Palace}.

guide.context: The kill total accumulates across characters and modes, so ordinary campaign progress is sufficient.

steps.text: Kill enemies in campaign missions or @loc{Bloody Palace} until the shared cumulative counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Defeat 1,000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Defeat 1,000 enemies across campaign missions or @loc{Bloody Palace}.

guide.context: The shared counter persists through every required mode clear and normally reaches 1,000 during the early completion route.

steps.text: Kill enemies in campaign missions or @loc{Bloody Palace} until the shared cumulative counter reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Complete a Stylish Rank S (Smokin'!) combo.
achievements.summary: Raise the live combat Style meter to @mechanic{S — Smokin'!} during one encounter.

guide.context: The meter rises faster when different attacks are chained and drops when the character is hit; longer-lived enemies provide more room to build rank.

steps.text: During an encounter with several durable enemies, rotate through distinct melee, ranged, launcher, aerial, and character-specific moves without taking damage until the meter displays @mechanic{S — Smokin'!}.

achievements.description: Complete a Stylish Rank SS (Smokin' Style!!) combo.
achievements.summary: Raise the live combat Style meter to @mechanic{SS — Smokin' Style!!} during one encounter.

guide.context: After a move stops adding meaningful Style, switching to an unused action preserves growth; getting hit can erase several ranks.

steps.text: Fight a durable group, keep every attacking enemy visible or off camera, and cycle through distinct melee, ranged, aerial, launcher, and special moves without taking damage until the meter reaches @mechanic{SS — Smokin' Style!!}.

achievements.description: Complete a Stylish Rank SSS (Smokin' Sick Style!!!) combo.
achievements.summary: Raise the live combat Style meter to @mechanic{SSS — Smokin' Sick Style!!!} during one encounter.

guide.context: Mission 9 opens with one Alto Angelo and three Bianco Angelos whose reflected group projectile grants a large Style increase.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 9} and wait for the Alto Angelo and three Bianco Angelos to retreat into a triangle and darken the arena while charging an energy ball.

Charge Nero's Blue Rose shot or Dante's shotgun, fire into the released energy ball to return it, and continue varied attacks without taking damage until the meter displays @mechanic{SSS — Smokin' Sick Style!!!}.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Legendary Dark Knight Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions on @mechanic{Legendary Dark Knight} with any character set.

guide.context: Legendary Dark Knight is available immediately, uses roughly Son of Sparda-strength enemies, and fills arenas with much larger groups.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Legendary Dark Knight}, choose any character set, and finish Missions 1–20 using crowd-control moves and Devil Trigger when the larger enemy groups surround you.

achievements.description: Clear all missions in Legendary Dark Knight Mode with an S Ranking.
achievements.summary: Record an overall S rank on Missions 1–20 on @mechanic{Legendary Dark Knight}.

guide.context: Its score rules follow Son of Sparda, while the extra enemies supply abundant Style points; survival is more valuable than chasing an S clear-time split.

steps.text: Use a normal costume and replay every @mechanic{Legendary Dark Knight} mission until Missions 1–20 each show an overall S rank, using crowd-control attacks while avoiding deaths, Continues, and Gold Orbs.

achievements.description: Clear the game with Vergil.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions as @npc{Vergil} on one difficulty mode.

guide.context: Difficulty unlocks and upgrades are shared between character sets, but Vergil's mission progress is separate; Heaven or Hell is fastest, while Legendary Dark Knight overlaps another requirement.

steps.text: Select @npc{Vergil} on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell} for speed or Legendary Dark Knight for route efficiency.
Finish Missions 1–20 with @npc{Vergil} on the selected mode.

achievements.description: Clear the game with Lady and Trish.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 campaign missions with the @npc{Lady/Trish} character pair on one difficulty mode.

guide.context: Shared difficulty unlocks let Lady/Trish enter any mode already opened by another character set; their campaign alternates the two characters like Nero/Dante.

steps.text: Select @npc{Lady/Trish} on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell} for speed or Hell and Hell to overlap another required mode clear.
Finish Missions 1–20 with the @npc{Lady/Trish} pair on the selected mode.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace stages with Nero.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 as @npc{Nero} in one run.

guide.context: Items are disabled and health does not refill automatically; Super Nero is eligible for this character-clear achievement.

steps.text: Unlock Nero's complete skill set and health upgrades, select @npc{Super Nero} in @loc{Bloody Palace}, and begin at stage 1.
Stay in Devil Trigger with maximum Exceed, preserve health across all 101 stages, use Charged Shot against Dante on stage 101, and defeat Dante to finish the run.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace stages with Dante.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 as @npc{Dante} in one run.

guide.context: Super Dante is eligible and supplies unlimited Devil Trigger, allowing Pandora's Gunslinger forms to remain active.

steps.text: Select @npc{Super Dante} in @loc{Bloody Palace}, enter Devil Trigger, equip Pandora, and choose Gunslinger.
On each stage, triple-jump and activate @mechanic{PF594: Argument}, fire its rockets until every enemy is dead, trigger any dormant floor enemies at close range, and defeat Dante on stage 101.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace stages with Vergil.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 as @npc{Vergil} in one run.

guide.context: Super Vergil is eligible, but Judgment Cut End leaves a brief vulnerable opening; Beowulf is safer against exposed single targets.

steps.text: Unlock Vergil's complete skill set, select @npc{Super Vergil} in @loc{Bloody Palace}, and begin at stage 1.
Use Judgment Cut End to erase groups when the opening is safe, use Rapid Slash into perfectly timed Judgment Cuts and Beowulf against single targets, and defeat Dante on stage 101.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace stages with Lady.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 as @npc{Lady} in one run.

guide.context: Lady has no Super costume, and keeping enemies off camera limits their attacks while her charged firearms continue to work without lock-on.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Bloody Palace} as @npc{Lady}; keep enemies off camera, charge the pistols, double-jump into Wire Shot's ground slam, release the pistol shot, fire a quick Kalina Ann shot, and return to the pistols.
Use level-2 or level-3 Kalina Ann shots on safe groups, charge the shotgun before portals for close targets, and reserve Burst to escape Blitz grabs.
Reach stage 101, keep distance from Dante, release level-3 pistol shots as he lands or commits to an attack, and reduce his health to zero without losing the run.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace stages with Trish.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 as @npc{Trish} in one run.

guide.context: Trish has no Super costume; full Devil Trigger should be reserved for Blitz stages 18, 25, 26, 29, 30, 38, 45, 63, 67, 85, and 89.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Bloody Palace} as @npc{Trish}, fight near the arena edge, keep enemies off camera, and combine Round Trip with Thunder Blow or Collider for each group.
Activate Devil Trigger and shoot Mephistos or Fausts until they fall, then use Round Trip and Thunder Blow; fire Pandora's Revenge to strip Blitz shields and damage bosses.

Enter stage 85 with full Devil Trigger, fire Pandora's Revenge immediately at one Blitz, destroy that Blitz before the second closes in, then preserve enough health to clear stages 86–101 and defeat Dante.

achievements.description: Clear all Bloody Palace stages with all characters.
achievements.summary: Clear all 101 @loc{Bloody Palace} stages separately as Nero, Dante, Vergil, Lady, and Trish.

guide.context: Character clears are tracked separately; Super costumes are allowed for Nero, Dante, and Vergil, while Lady and Trish must use their normal costumes.

steps.text: Complete one full stages-1–101 @loc{Bloody Palace} run as @npc{Nero}, one as @npc{Dante}, and one as @npc{Vergil}.
Complete one full stages-1–101 @loc{Bloody Palace} run as @npc{Lady} and one as @npc{Trish}.

achievements.description: Clear the Bloody Palace within 2 hours.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 in less than two hours during one run.

guide.context: Super Dante can finish in roughly 30–40 minutes with Pandora, leaving a large margin without enabling Turbo.

steps.text: Select @npc{Super Dante}, equip Pandora and Gunslinger, enter Devil Trigger, and start @loc{Bloody Palace}.
Use airborne @mechanic{PF594: Argument} rockets to clear every stage and defeat Dante on stage 101 before the run timer reaches two hours.

achievements.description: Defeat Dante in the Bloody Palace without taking any damage.
achievements.summary: Reach @loc{Bloody Palace stage 101} and defeat @enemy{Dante} without taking any damage during that fight.

guide.context: Damage on stages 1–100 does not affect this condition. Airborne Pandora rockets are safer than PF422: Grief because Dante can Royalguard Grief.

steps.text: Use @npc{Super Dante} to clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–100, then enter stage 101 with Pandora and Gunslinger ready.

Immediately run or Trickster away from @enemy{Dante}, activate Devil Trigger, triple-jump into @mechanic{PF594: Argument}, and fire rockets until Dante is defeated without any attack touching the player.

achievements.description: Clear the Bloody Palace in Turbo Mode.
achievements.summary: Enable @mechanic{Turbo Mode} before a run, then clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101.

guide.context: Turbo accelerates the entire game by 20%; Super Nero, Dante, or Vergil remains eligible for this clear.

steps.text: Open Options and switch @mechanic{Turbo Mode} on before entering Bloody Palace.
Choose a Super version of Nero, Dante, or Vergil and clear @loc{Bloody Palace} stages 1–101 without disabling Turbo during the run.

achievements.description: Defeat Dante with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Dante} while the live Style meter reads SSS on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: The finishing hit must land while SSS is visible; Mission 1 on Dante Must Die gives Dante enough health for Lady's safe ranged sequence.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 1} on @mechanic{Dante Must Die} as @npc{Lady} and begin charging her pistols.

Jump, use Wire Shot two or three times until @enemy{Dante} is launched, release the charged pistol shot while he is airborne, and continue the same named sequence without taking damage until a charged shot kills him while SSS is visible.

achievements.description: Defeat Berial with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Berial} while the live Style meter reads SSS on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: Super costumes are allowed; when Berial's flames go out he can be Bustered both in the air and on the ground for large Style gains.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 2} on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} as @npc{Super Nero}, charge Blue Rose before the arena, then hit Berial with Charged Shot, Maximum Bet, Streak, and head strikes until his flames extinguish.
Buster @enemy{Berial's} head while airborne and again on the ground, back away for additional Charged Shots, and use Devil Trigger activation invulnerability against the charging attack.
When the meter reaches S and Berial loses his flames again, land the airborne and grounded Busters so the final blow kills Berial while SSS is visible.

achievements.description: Defeat Bael or Dagon with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Bael or Dagon} while the live Style meter reads SSS on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: Super Nero's maximum Exceed and Devil Trigger activation invulnerability make the Mission 4 Bael fight the most direct attempt.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 4} on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} as @npc{Super Nero}, use Streak on the Rusalka feelers, and Buster each feeler when it is stunned or begins an attack.
Strike @enemy{Bael's} ice crystals, use Devil Trigger activation to avoid incoming damage, and Buster Bael's face whenever the broken crystals leave the boss stunned.
Keep varying Charged Shot, Red Queen, and Buster attacks without being hit, then make the finishing Buster land while SSS is visible.

achievements.description: Defeat Echidna with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Echidna} while the live Style meter reads SSS on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: Bloody Palace also qualifies because it uses Son of Sparda difficulty, but Mission 7 or 13 provides a quicker restart.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Echidna} on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} or higher, combine Nero's Charged Shot with varied Red Queen attacks, and avoid damage while the Style meter rises.
When Echidna enters flower form, stun her and Buster the body; in spider form, Buster the exposed egg sac for another large Style gain.
Reduce Echidna's remaining health with safe varied attacks and land the killing blow while SSS is visible.

achievements.description: Defeat Angelo Credo with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Angelo Credo} while the live Style meter reads SSS in Mission 8 on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: Credo's shield Busters and returned spears provide the largest controlled Style gains; being hit can erase two Style grades.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 8} on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} or higher as Nero, avoid Credo's sword combo, and Buster his shield after the final downward slash.
When @enemy{Angelo Credo} throws three spears, dodge the first two, catch the third with Devil Bringer without lock-on, then hold lock-on and release Devil Bringer to throw the spear back.
Use Charged Shot 3 between openings, Buster Credo when his shield stops glowing, build the meter to SSS during the stagger, and kill him before SSS falls.

achievements.description: Defeat Angelo Agnus with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Angelo Agnus} while the live Style meter reads SSS on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: Super costumes and Holy Water are allowed; Holy Water is safest only after SSS appears because its purpose is preserving the final rank.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 9} on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} as @npc{Super Nero}, rotate Red Queen attacks, Charged Shot, and Devil Bringer while avoiding Agnus's attacks.
Whenever @enemy{Angelo Agnus} is stunned and loses the yellow aura, Buster him for a large Style increase.
After the meter reaches SSS, kill Agnus with another safe Buster or use Holy Water to remove the remaining health before the Style rank falls.

achievements.description: Defeat The Savior with an SSS ranking in Son of Sparda Mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Sanctus Diabolica} in Mission 20 while the live Style meter reads SSS on Son of Sparda or higher.

guide.context: The Steam description names The Savior, but Mission 11 cannot award this achievement; the qualifying target is Sanctus Diabolica at the end of Mission 20.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 20} on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} or higher as Nero and reduce @enemy{Sanctus Diabolica} to about two health bars without pushing far below that point.
Break Sanctus's barrier, stand at medium distance without lock-on, and hold Devil Bringer as his Stinger-like charge begins so Nero Busters the charge and raises Style.
Break the restored barrier without taking damage, Buster the next Stinger-like charge, and make that second Buster kill Sanctus while SSS is visible.

achievements.description: Defeat 10,000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Defeat 10,000 enemies across all campaign modes and @loc{Bloody Palace} runs.

guide.context: The cumulative counter includes every character and mode. The required campaign and five Bloody Palace clears contribute most of the total before dedicated farming is needed.

steps.text: Complete the required seven campaign modes and five character-specific @loc{Bloody Palace} runs before checking whether the cumulative kill total has reached 10,000.

If the counter is short, load @loc{Mission 10} on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}, reach the pressure-plate gate, and kill the Scarecrow beside the mechanism without passing through the gate so that named Scarecrow continues spawning.
Keep killing each newly spawned Scarecrow at the Mission 10 pressure-plate gate until the cumulative enemy counter reaches 10,000.

achievements.displayName: Wrath Of The Raging Demon Hunter
achievements.description: Defeat 10 enemies within 1 second.
achievements.summary: Kill at least 10 enemies inside a single one-second window.

guide.context: Heaven or Hell can award this naturally, but Legendary Dark Knight provides a dense group for a controlled area attack.

steps.text: Start an early @mechanic{Legendary Dark Knight} mission as @npc{Vergil} and let at least 10 enemies gather within Judgment Cut End's range.
Enter Devil Trigger with high Concentration and execute @mechanic{Judgment Cut End} so at least 10 gathered enemies die inside the same one-second window.
